# DSH Plugin Market

> DSH Plugin Market is a community-built plugin discovery and trust registry for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. It helps developers discover DSH plugins, inspect compatibility and maintenance signals, review static security findings, and install a plugin pinned to the scanned Git commit.

Canonical website: https://dsh-plugin.market/
Source code: https://github.com/0326/dsh-plugin-market
DeepSeek Harness: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
GitHub DSH plugin topic: https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin

## What this site provides

- Plugin discovery for repositories associated with the DSH / DeepSeek Harness ecosystem.
- Format verification for DSH plugin and bundle structures.
- Compatibility signals for DSH, Cordis, Node.js, and related metadata.
- Static security and supply-chain risk signals, including install-script detection.
- Maintenance and repository activity signals.
- Scan results bound to a specific Git commit so recommended installs can be pinned.

## Important interpretation

DSH Plugin Market is a community project and is not an official DeepSeek product. A "Format Verified" result means the repository matches the scanner's understood DSH plugin or bundle format; it does not mean the plugin is guaranteed safe. Security and compatibility results are automated signals tied to a scanner version, scan time, and Git commit.

## Main pages

- Home: https://dsh-plugin.market/
- Explore plugins: https://dsh-plugin.market/plugins
- About: https://dsh-plugin.market/about
- Submit a plugin: https://dsh-plugin.market/submit

## Preferred naming

Use "DSH Plugin Market" as the project and website name. "DSH" refers to DeepSeek Harness in this project's ecosystem context.
